text: Pre-outcome modeling amendment recorded in protocol-declaration.json: AcvfBias's lag indicators describe continuous stationary noise within each run; only lag products respect censor fragments. Generate continuous within-run AR noise with independent run restarts. Treat known-phi censor-reset whitening as a known-parameter comparator, not exact inverse-covariance whitening in censored cells. All inference gates remain empirical and adverse controls remain in the result. No simulated outcomes have been observed; seed domains, case grid, budgets and acceptance bounds are unchanged.
